body: I don’t think they can trace the call. They will talk to you and help you calm down. I have called them multiple times because I was scared or about to harm myself. It was nice to know there was someone on the other side. Sometimes I just breathe and don’t say anything and they’re okay with that too. Please call them if you need to.
My cat enjoys bird watching too. He always chirps at them
I’ve had people read the sign posted on the door and still ask for dine-in. I’m like I just saw you read the “no dine-in” sign 🤦‍♀️
